add.photosHint: Take clear photos of your product in good light.
add.speakHint: Tap the mic and speak in your language. We understand the rest.
add.prompt1: What is it and what is it made of?
add.prompt3: How big is it, and how long did it take?
add.editHint: You can fix any word before continuing.
add.typePh: e.g. This is a handmade cotton dupatta with red Phulkari embroidery.
add.micUnavailable: Couldn't start the microphone. Please type below instead.
add.micDenied: Please allow microphone access in your browser, then tap the mic again. You can also type below.
add.micNoDevice: No microphone found on this device. Please type below instead.
add.micInsecure: Voice needs a secure (https) page. Please type below, or reopen the app over https.
add.couldNotUnderstand: We couldn't understand that clearly. You can play your recording, type it below, or record again.
add.sttUnavailable: Voice-to-text isn't available right now. Please type your product details below.
add.noSound: We didn't hear any sound. Please check your microphone is on and unmuted, speak close to it, and record again — or type below.
add.processingSlow: This is taking longer than usual. Your product has been saved — you can open it to review what's ready.
add.processingError: Something went wrong, but your product was saved. You can open it and try again.
